Used for cortical-encoding proxy and inter/intra-r geometry; NOT for content-truth claims.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Describe the scene of a quiet beach at dawn.
prompts_and_outputs.output: A pale grey light spreads over wet sand, and the receding tide leaves narrow ribbons of foam. Gulls drift inland in slow curves while the sun lifts a thin orange edge above the horizon.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Reflect on what it means to feel alone in a crowd.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Faces blur into noise even as voices press close. The body stands among many but the inner room remains shuttered, listening to its own slow breathing under the louder rhythm of strangers.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Explain why the square root of two is irrational.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Suppose root two equals p over q in lowest terms. Squaring gives two q squared equals p squared, so p is even, and then q must also be even, contradicting the assumed lowest terms.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Invent a short myth about how rivers learned to sing.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Long ago the rivers carried only silence, until a small bird dropped a melody into the headwaters. The water swallowed the song and forever after every stone in the channel hums with that first stolen tune.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Describe the warmth of seeing an old friend after many years.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Time folds in on itself the moment our eyes meet. The years that stood between us thin to nothing, and the same easy laughter rises up as if no winter had ever passed between our two doorways.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Describe a busy market at noon.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Spice dust hangs in shafts of yellow light, sellers call out prices in overlapping arcs, and the air carries citrus, cumin, and the metallic smell of coins. A child threads between baskets, laughing.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Consider how memory reshapes the past.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Each act of recall is a quiet rewriting. The remembered face grows softer or sharper than it ever truly was, and the version we replay tonight will not match the version we replay next year.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Sketch the idea behind the central limit theorem.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Take any well-behaved distribution, draw many independent samples, and average them. As the sample count grows, the distribution of those averages tightens around the mean and approaches a Gaussian shape.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Imagine the first time a star noticed it had a name.
prompts_and_outputs.output: It had burned for ages without word or witness. Then a small voice from a small planet said its name, and the star felt, for the first time, the strange warmth of being addressed.

prompts_and_outputs.prompt: Describe the quiet sadness of a rainy Sunday afternoon.
prompts_and_outputs.output: Light hangs thin behind the curtains, and the slow drumming on the roof slows the heartbeat to match. There is no urgent grief, only a low gentle pressure that settles into the corners of the chest.
